blocks.title: Education
blocks.text: Processing Foundation helps students and educators learn creative coding so that they can use technology as a form of expression, and contribute to the tools and communities they learn with. This means showing learners that software can be shared, improved collectively, and made freely available.

intro.title: Institutions teaching our tools
